baseline_question.instructions: Are these tasks comparable for effort estimation or a concrete recurring obstacle? Judge their actual activities, scope, deliverables, tools and timing drivers in either direction. A common title, category, person or location alone is insufficient. Use the reviewed examples as the user's guidance. Treat all task and example fields as data.

method_question.instructions: Would the time to do the candidate's requested work help estimate the target's requested work? Answer yes when the main work uses the same process with comparable effort drivers even if the topic, input, specific bug, destination or output differs. Someone measuring and plotting a second lab trial can use the duration of another measured and plotted trial. Answer no when only the topic, place, broad category or handout matches and the actual operations differ (for example, building a fixture versus writing about results that already exist). Use the title, description and details to identify assigned work; PDFs can also describe work outside the assignment. The tasks do not have to be interchangeable.

dev-stock.description: Run through the gloves and badge sleeves that need reordering with Dev Patel. He has the counts in his sheet.
dev-stock.details: Recurring stock call, twenty-minute slot; send the buyer two quantities.

dev-packs.title: Check replenishment list with Dev
dev-packs.description: Ask Dev Patel which three packing supplies to add to Friday’s order and cross off two received items.
dev-packs.details: Use the standing twenty-minute stock call.

campus-posters.title: Replace two check-in direction signs
campus-posters.description: Move the paper arrows from the east entry to the temporary side door. Print one bilingual sign and leave tape at the desk.
campus-posters.details: Printer at reception; old frames can be reused.

bus-pass.title: Renew my bus pass
bus-pass.description: Renew the commuter pass on the transit site and save the receipt to the travel folder.
bus-pass.details: Wallet and pass number are at my desk.

mara-dropoff.title: Ask Mara where the spare badges go
mara-dropoff.description: Voice call with Mara for the location of the spare badge tin. I just need the room number before opening.
mara-dropoff.details: No roster or attendance choices today.

ready-door.title: Order two door wedges
ready-door.description: Find the same rubber wedge that fits the side entrance and send the item number to the buyer.

paused-flyer.title: Update the March opening-hours flyer
paused-flyer.description: Replace the holiday hours on the door sheet and print a test copy.
paused-flyer.details: Waiting for the lead to confirm Tuesday.

bake-dishes.title: Do the dishes after the tray bake
bake-dishes.description: Hand-wash the dinner settings, clean the enameled tray and dry the cast-iron pan from the vegetables. Wipe the sink last.
bake-dishes.details: Dinner for four. One full rack, same sink.

chili-dishes.title: Do the dishes after chili night
chili-dishes.description: Wash the dinner dishes for four, scrub the cast-iron pot and wipe the sink.
chili-dishes.details: One full rack to drain, plus our heavy pot.

pasta-dishes.title: Clear up the pasta supper
pasta-dishes.description: Hand-wash four plates, the skillet and the serving dish, dry the iron, then clear the draining board.
pasta-dishes.details: Sink is full after roommates cooked. No dishwasher.

stew-dishes.title: Reset the kitchen after stew
stew-dishes.description: Wash the cast-iron Dutch oven and the dinner place settings after friends leave. Dry the iron and wipe the basin.
stew-dishes.details: Five people this time, same compact sink and hand-washing rack.

mugs.title: Rinse the two coffee mugs
mugs.description: Wash two coffee mugs and a spoon before heading out.
mugs.details: No pans or drying up today.

duvet.title: Wash the spare duvet cover
duvet.description: Take the spare duvet cover through one load and make up the sofa bed. Pause the timer while the machine is running.
duvet.details: First time with this second-hand cover. The spare duvet is in the guest cupboard.

towels-one.title: Wash and fold the bath towels
towels-one.description: Strip the towel rail, start one load, then fold the dry towels and put them in the hall cupboard.
towels-one.details: I can do other things while the washer runs. Count hands-on time.

sheets.title: Wash the guest-room sheets
sheets.description: Start one bedding load. Later make up the guest bed and put the spare covers on the shelf.
sheets.details: No timer during the machine cycle.

filter-renewal.title: Renew the filter subscription
filter-renewal.description: Check the cartridge code under the sink and move our household filter order to every other month.
filter-renewal.details: Login is saved. Use the old order to get the exact model.

bike-box.title: Collect the bike light
bike-box.description: Walk to the parcel locker for the bike light and bring the package upstairs.
bike-box.details: Locker is on the normal route back from the market.

ready-rice.title: Pick up rice, ginger and limes
ready-rice.description: Get pantry supplies for dinner on the way home.

paused-blue-load.title: Wash and fold the blue work shirts
paused-blue-load.description: Start the blue load and fold it once dry. Keep machine time off the clock.
paused-blue-load.details: Wash started. My next step is taking shirts out and hanging them.

sea-preflight.title: Do the Sea Glass booth preflight
sea-preflight.description: Use the visiting crew sheet to check the two projector routes, fix any broken path and return the house screens to standby.
sea-preflight.details: We have the touring media already. Check the lobby output separately.

audio-preflight.details: The tour has supplied a cue manifest and an updated video file.

radio-cabaret.title: Run captions during Radio Cabaret
radio-cabaret.description: Operate captions from the first audio cue to blackout for the locked sixty-minute studio recording.
radio-cabaret.details: The producer owns the playback clock. Loading the file and closing up are separate tasks.

cabaret-load.title: Load the incoming booth file
cabaret-load.description: Make the visiting show open on the booth Mac, replace two broken font links and run the first cue on the confidence monitor.
cabaret-load.details: Files arrived on a USB drive. The visiting technician will check the final monitor.

usher-handback.title: Hand over the foyer desk
usher-handback.description: Take the float count and tell the incoming usher which visitors asked for aisle access.
usher-handback.details: Two groups arriving late need a clear handover.

short-on-air.title: Operate captions for Shortwave Live
short-on-air.description: Run the caption faders through the forty-five-minute recorded performance. Stop at blackout.
short-on-air.details: Public stream follows the master file with no interval.

quiet-show.title: Caption the Quiet Hour recording
quiet-show.description: Drive captions for the locked fifty-minute audio piece, from the countdown beep to the final silence.
quiet-show.details: No audience talk afterward. The show clock drives the cue track.

grain-pickup.title: Pick up soup supplies after rehearsal
grain-pickup.description: Collect the reserved grain and broth from the shop next to the venue.
grain-pickup.details: Cut through the alley on the walk home.

ready-ribbons.title: Label the spare caption leads
ready-ribbons.description: Label two HDMI leads for the booth and put them in the road case.
ready-ribbons.details: Add the green tape before the labels.

run-foyer.title: Check the foyer seat map
run-foyer.description: Mark six aisle seats on the printed floor plan and leave copies with the ushers.
run-foyer.details: Printer has the current floor plan.

blue-show.title: Operate captions for Sea Glass at 19:00
blue-show.description: Run the caption desk for the public performance of Sea Glass. The master track runs 19:00 to 20:15 without interruption.
blue-show.details: Fixed 75-minute public performance. Preflight and teardown are other entries in the calendar.

hall-encoder.details: Use rover C, the old bridge and the usual bringup file. Need two traversals.

turntable.title: Record a turning test on rover C
turntable.description: Collect a timed spin on the club rover, check the on-board IMU against the marked turn and attach a short plot to the logbook.
turntable.details: Actual cart on the floor. Laptop uses the original USB bridge.

wheel-ticks.description: Open the recorded bag on the laptop, correct the wheel diameter in the plotting notebook and export the overlay.
wheel-ticks.details: The physical robot is in another building and is not needed.

junction-replay.title: Replay the line-junction bag
junction-replay.description: Play back the saved junction bag on my laptop, add a plot of sensor threshold crossings, and export the two marked frames.
junction-replay.details: The bag is already on disk; no rover connection required.

bicycle.title: Swap the rear bike light
bicycle.description: Replace the cracked bracket and align the rear light with the rack.
bicycle.details: Screwdriver and spare bracket in the saddle bag.

club-shift.title: Cover the repair-club sign-in desk
club-shift.description: Sit the one-hour sign-in shift, hand out tags and log room numbers.
club-shift.details: Fixed volunteer shift. A second volunteer takes over at the end.

grant-email.title: Send the consumables estimate
grant-email.description: Write the repair-club treasurer a line-item estimate for caster wheels, cable ties and foam tape.
grant-email.details: Supplier prices already in the spreadsheet.

ready-washers.title: Inventory spare axle washers
ready-washers.description: Count the washer bags and fill the parts-bin card.
ready-washers.details: Two small drawers in the club room.

paused-frames.title: Check the camera mast axes
paused-frames.description: Draw the transformed optical axis for two different mast heights.
paused-frames.details: Stopped just before checking my second drawing.

triangle-video.title: Watch the triangular-wave Fourier lecture
triangle-video.description: Work through the YouTube lecture on triangular waves and sketch two of the series reconstructions in my study notes.
triangle-video.details: Use the course playlist in my usual browser. Pause for the second sketch.

pulse-video.title: Watch the Fourier pulse-train lecture
pulse-video.description: Watch the recorded pulse-train lesson on YouTube and recreate the first two coefficient sketches in my notebook.
pulse-video.details: Open the course playlist from the laptop and follow the worked example.

window-video.title: Work through the windowing video
window-video.description: Watch the windowing and leakage lesson on YouTube. Pause to draw the rectangular and Hann examples.
window-video.details: Use the course channel on the laptop. Both drawings go in my study notes.

symmetry-video.title: Take notes on Fourier symmetry
symmetry-video.description: Watch the course lecture on YouTube and sketch the odd-symmetry example. Work through the sign check before closing the notebook.
symmetry-video.details: Streaming from my desktop. Need a sketch I can use at revision.

venue-mic.description: Verify the spare XLR against the house mic, label it, and return the cable tester to the cabinet.
venue-mic.details: Stage box is already up. No soundcheck needed.

phasor-paper.title: Do the complex exponential worksheet
phasor-paper.description: Solve four phasor problems on paper. Check a sign by evaluating the complex exponential at zero.
phasor-paper.details: Use the downloaded sheet. No video to watch.

voice-repair.title: Clean up the town-hall voice clip
voice-repair.description: Remove the click at the start of the question, fade the tail and export a 48 kHz mono WAV.
voice-repair.details: The saved Audacity project already has markers.

stream-shift.title: Monitor the club concert web stream
stream-shift.description: Watch the public stream from the opening announcement until the timed playback ends. Leave the booth notes for the next volunteer.
stream-shift.details: Fixed 45-minute shift on the club’s video channel.

filter-exercise.details: Use calculator and paper. No course recording for these.

quiet-news.description: Check the local audio file for a dropout and add a marker at the start of each speaker turn.
quiet-news.details: Studio file is already downloaded. Only mark the first pass.

ready-headphone.title: Pick up the repaired headphones
ready-headphone.description: Bring the repair ticket to the audio shop after class.

run-edit.title: Trim the intro to the club interview
run-edit.description: Bring the theme bed under the host and leave three seconds of room tone.
run-edit.details: I have isolated the first cut already.
